candidate_breakdown.q1_text: Hi my name is Nursultan and I am applying to inVision U because I want to challenge myself and become more active. I often feel that I have potential but I do not always use opportunities in the right way, so I want to join something that can push me and also show me how to work with other motivated students.
candidate_breakdown.q2_text: The program I am interested in is maybe entrepreneurship or innovation related one because I like idea of creating something useful. I am not saying I already know how to build projects very well, but I want to learn how people take idea and make it more real. This is interesting for me because I do not want only theory, I want something practical too.
candidate_breakdown.q3_text: A challenge I overcame was when I joined a university event team and at first I felt very uncomfortable because many people already knew each other and I was more quiet. I was afraid to say something stupid. What helped me was that I started with small tasks, like checking lists and helping with communication, and after some time I felt more confident. It was important for me because I understood that even if I am not the loudest person, I still can contribute.
candidate_breakdown.q4_text: My long term goal is to become a professional who can manage projects or maybe work in business development. I still do not know exact job title, but I know I want to be in a role where I solve problems and communicate with people. This program can help me by giving experience, network, and maybe better understanding of what kind of work fits me. What motivates me is progress, when I can see that I am better than before.
candidate_breakdown.q5_text: Leadership for me means helping a group move forward, especially when people are confused or passive. I had one example during a group assignment where two members did not understand what topic we should present. I said we should first agree on one structure, then split the parts, and I stayed after class to make sure everyone understood. I was not the official leader, but I think in that moment I helped the team work better.
candidate_breakdown.q6_text: My family supports me, especially my mother. She always says that if I have a chance to develop myself, I should take it seriously and not be lazy.
